title: Practice 7: при- and у-: arriving, and leaving

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: High pressure caused the pipe to burst.
exercises.why: Notice that the prefix при- expresses the idea of arriving, while the prefix у- expresses the idea of leaving. Note. — The verbs приходить and приезжать usually refer to the habitual or repeated actions: Он приходит (приезжает) сюда каждый день. — He comes here every day. These verbs, as the other verbs of motion, may be used to express a single action in the future: Он приходит на работу завтра утром. — He is coming to work tomorrow morning. Она приезжает из Москвы сегодня вечером. — She is coming (arriving) from Moscow this evening. When the action is in progress in the present such expressions as "He is coming" or "He is on the way here" are expressed in Russian in the following way: Кто… — DLI, Lesson 24.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Notice that the prefix при- expresses the idea of arriving, while the prefix у- expresses the idea of leaving. (DLI, Lesson 24)

exercises.why: **уе́хать** — **уезжа́ть** — to go away, to drive off, to leave, to depart (by conveyance). **улете́ть** — **улета́ть** — to fly away, to depart (by flying); (figuratively) to be carried away or transported in thoughts or feelings. **убежа́ть** — **убега́ть** — to run away, to make off, to flee; to escape. **уплы́ть** — **уплыва́ть** — to swim away; to sail away. **унести́** — **уноси́ть** — to take away, to take off, to carry (away); (figuratively) to take (a life), to claim (a life). — DLI, Lesson 24.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: уе́хать** — **уезжа́ть — to go away, to drive off, to leave, to depart (by conveyance).

exercises.why: **убежа́ть** — **убега́ть** — to run away, to make off, to flee; to escape. **уплы́ть** — **уплыва́ть** — to swim away; to sail away. **унести́** — **уноси́ть** — to take away, to take off, to carry (away); (figuratively) to take (a life), to claim (a life). **увести́** — **уводи́ть** — to take away, to lead away, to withdraw (troops); to carry off, to lift. **увезти́** — **увози́ть** — to take away, to carry away (by vehicle); to abduct, to kidnap. — DLI, Lesson 24.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
